evidence.visible_region: The entire content area below the source identity row, approximately y=140 through the bottom of the 618-by-824 image, is blank. The header caption says configured.
requirements: HANDOFF.md section 5.4 and docs/DESIGN_HANDOFF.md lines 389-391 require real paginated source results with five Paperwhite rows and a folio.
The scope baseline requires truthful operation states; the prototype support map requires setup-needed and empty states to remain distinguishable.

suggestions.recommendation: Make the View-all destination render the returned source results and its folio. Reconcile the setup-needed state with the configured provider used by search; if setup truly blocks the catalog, display the honest setup state and a usable configuration action instead of an unexplained blank page.

limitations: This is an independent static review of only the eight candidate PNGs listed in supplemental-07.input.json. Every listed candidate was directly viewed; no other PNG or standalone reference image was loaded.
The review used scope, handoff and prototype text for acceptance. Without independent reference images, it does not assert pixel-level equivalence or complete coverage of the full application matrix.

Existing case checks and provider-request evidence were inspected as supplied provenance. No application, build, test, validation suite, runtime probe, Git operation or product modification was performed locally or remotely for this review.

These HTTP cases show one fixture source. Static frames and supplied sidecars do not independently prove multi-source concurrency, tap-target sizes, focus accessibility, outside dismissal, keyboard editing behavior, or persisted interaction behavior.
No physical e-ink waveform, hardware capability, sleep/wake restoration, or 512 MiB memory qualification is inferred from these PNGs.
This batch contains one actionable suggestion and does not establish a complete clean review round.
